findings.issue: The lesson names the pattern ~ないうちに (objective + checklist) but illustrates it with the ていない form 降っていないうちに. That form literally does mean 'enquanto não está chovendo', which is exactly the reading the note denies; the canonical negative is 降らないうちに.
findings.current: 降っていないうちに ... traduz-se por 'antes que comece a chover', e não 'enquanto não chove'
findings.suggested: 降らないうちに (reading ふらないうちに) — 'antes que comece a chover'

findings.issue: Cloze answer key is malformed: answer.text repeats the blanked sentence instead of the missing token. The batch convention (see ex:n3-causa-08-3, text='料金') is that text holds the filler. A learner answering まで would be graded wrong.
findings.current: "text": "疲れる___走った", "full": "疲れるまで走った"

findings.issue: The ~ないうちに pitfall illustrates the negative with the ている-negative 降っていないうちに, which is not the pattern the objective/checklist name (～ないうちに) and is not the idiomatic form; the standard example is 雨が降らないうちに ('antes que comece a chover'). Same mismatch stems from the formation line listing only 'verbo na forma ている + うちに'.
findings.current: <jp reading="ふっていないうちに">降っていないうちに</jp> ... traduz-se por 'antes que comece a chover'
findings.suggested: <jp reading="あめがふらないうちに">雨が降らないうちに</jp> (formação: verbo na forma ない + うちに)
